sections.title: Positive traits
sections.content:
People often have a mix of characteristics. Here are some advanced adjectives for describing positive personality traits:
• conscientious — careful and thorough in work. She's incredibly conscientious about meeting deadlines.
• compassionate — showing deep concern for others. A compassionate leader listens to everyone's problems.
• resilient — able to recover from difficulties. After losing his job, he proved how resilient he was.
• versatile — able to adapt to many different activities. She's a versatile employee who can handle any department.
• diligent — showing careful and persistent effort. Diligent students often achieve the best results.

sections.title: Negative traits
sections.content:
Some adjectives describe less desirable characteristics:
• arrogant — having an exaggerated sense of importance. His arrogant attitude made him unpopular.
• stubborn — refusing to change one's mind. She can be incredibly stubborn once she's made a decision.
• impulsive — acting without thinking. His impulsive spending left him in debt.
• self-centred — concerned only with oneself. Self-centred people rarely consider how others feel.
• vindictive — seeking revenge. A vindictive colleague can create a toxic workplace.

sections.title: Complex characters
sections.content:
Some words describe personalities that are more nuanced:
• enigmatic — mysterious and difficult to understand. The new director has an enigmatic personality.
• unassuming — modest, not drawing attention. Despite his wealth, he remained remarkably unassuming.
• forthright — direct and honest in manner. I appreciate her forthright approach to feedback.
• shrewd — having sharp judgement. A shrewd businessperson knows when to invest.

exercises.question: Someone who is careful and thorough in their work is described as:
exercises.hint: Think about being thorough at work.
exercises.explanation: Conscientious means careful and diligent about doing things correctly.

exercises.question: If a person refuses to change their mind despite strong arguments, they are:
exercises.hint: This is generally seen as a negative trait.
exercises.explanation: Stubborn describes someone who won't change their position or opinion.

exercises.question: A person who is modest and doesn't seek attention is:
Which word means 'able to recover quickly from difficulties'?
exercises.hint: Think of bouncing back from hard times.
exercises.explanation: Resilient describes the ability to recover quickly from tough situations.

exercises.question: A person who acts without thinking about consequences is:
exercises.explanation: Impulsive means acting suddenly without careful thought.

exercises.question: Someone who shows deep sympathy for others' suffering is:
exercises.explanation: Compassionate means feeling concern for the suffering of others.

exercises.question: Which word describes someone who is mysterious and hard to understand?
exercises.explanation: Enigmatic means difficult to interpret or understand.

exercises.question: A person with sharp practical judgement in business is:
exercises.explanation: Shrewd means having sharp powers of judgement, especially in practical matters.
